description: Decode all EVM transaction event logs (ERC-20/721/1155, Uniswap V2/V3 swaps, approvals, CCTP, EIP-3009) + net asset flows, OR preflight-simulate unsigned calldata across 8 EVM chains (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, arc, robinhood). $0.004 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

chain.description: ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, arc or robinhood

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

tx.description: tx hash (0x + 64 hex) to decode mined logs
